1. 仓库结构（要求 Cursor 按此生成完整代码）
plate-fbg-shape-recon/
  README.md
  pyproject.toml
  Makefile
  .gitignore

  configs/
    default.yaml
    model/
      mamba.yaml
      transformer.yaml
    basis/
      dct.yaml
      spline.yaml
    data/
      schema.yaml
    train.yaml
    eval.yaml

  plate_recon/
    __init__.py
    types.py

    data/
      io.py
      preprocess.py
      align.py
      dataset.py
      transforms.py

    geometry/
      path.py          # s->(x,y), tangent, resample
      grid.py          # 50mm grid utilities
      normalize.py

    basis/
      dct2.py          # 2D cosine/sine basis + derivatives
      spline2.py       # optional
      bc.py            # hard-BC gating g(y)
      projection.py    # fit coeffs from full-field w (supervised)

    physics/
      curvature.py     # w_xx,w_xy,w_yy + kappa_t operator
      measurement.py   # map coeffs->w->kappa_t at fiber points
      losses.py        # huber, hf-regularization, bc loss

    models/
      encoders/
        mamba_encoder.py
        transformer_encoder.py
      heads/
        coeff_head.py
      plate_model.py   # end-to-end: encode -> coeffs -> physics decode

    baselines/
      ridge_fit.py     # solve A a ≈ kappa, Tikhonov
      metrics.py

    train/
      train.py
      eval.py
      callbacks.py
      logger.py

    viz/
      plots.py
      render3d.py

  scripts/
    preprocess_data.py
    fit_baseline.py
    train_model.py
    infer.py
    export_mesh.py

  tests/
    test_basis_derivatives.py
    test_measurement_operator.py
    test_alignment.py
    test_ridge_baseline.py

+ .PHONY: setup install dev lint format test train eval baseline preprocess viz clean help
+ 
+ # ============================================================================
+ # plate-fbg-shape-recon Makefile
+ # ============================================================================
+ 
+ PYTHON := python3
+ PIP := pip
+ PROJECT := plate_recon
+ 
+ # 默认配置文件
+ CONFIG ?= configs/default.yaml
+ DATA_DIR ?= data
+ OUTPUT_DIR ?= outputs
+ CHECKPOINT ?= outputs/best.pt
+ 
+ # ============================================================================
+ # 安装与环境
+ # ============================================================================
+ 
+ setup: ## 创建虚拟环境并安装依赖
+ 	$(PYTHON) -m venv .venv
+ 	. .venv/bin/activate &amp;&amp; $(PIP) install --upgrade pip
+ 	. .venv/bin/activate &amp;&amp; $(PIP) install -e ".[dev]"
+ 	@echo "✅ 环境设置完成。运行 'source .venv/bin/activate' 激活环境"
+ 
+ install: ## 安装项目（生产模式）
+ 	$(PIP) install -e .
+ 
+ dev: ## 安装项目（开发模式，含所有可选依赖）
+ 	$(PIP) install -e ".[dev,mamba,viz]"
+ 
+ # ============================================================================
+ # 代码质量
+ # ============================================================================
+ 
+ lint: ## 运行代码检查 (ruff + mypy)
+ 	ruff check $(PROJECT) scripts tests
+ 	mypy $(PROJECT) --ignore-missing-imports
+ 
+ format: ## 格式化代码 (black + ruff)
+ 	black $(PROJECT) scripts tests
+ 	ruff check --fix $(PROJECT) scripts tests
+ 
+ # ============================================================================
+ # 测试
+ # ============================================================================
+ 
+ test: ## 运行所有测试
+ 	pytest tests/ -v --cov=$(PROJECT) --cov-report=term-missing
+ 
+ test-fast: ## 快速测试（不含覆盖率）
+ 	pytest tests/ -v -x
+ 
+ test-basis: ## 测试基函数模块
+ 	pytest tests/test_basis_derivatives.py -v
+ 
+ test-measurement: ## 测试测量算子
+ 	pytest tests/test_measurement_operator.py -v
+ 
+ test-alignment: ## 测试数据对齐
+ 	pytest tests/test_alignment.py -v
+ 
+ test-baseline: ## 测试岭回归基线
+ 	pytest tests/test_ridge_baseline.py -v
+ 
+ # ============================================================================
+ # 数据处理
+ # ============================================================================
+ 
+ preprocess: ## 预处理原始数据
+ 	$(PYTHON) scripts/preprocess_data.py \
+ 		--config $(CONFIG) \
+ 		--input-dir $(DATA_DIR)/raw \
+ 		--output-dir $(DATA_DIR)/processed
+ 
+ # ============================================================================
+ # 训练与评估
+ # ============================================================================
+ 
+ train: ## 训练神经网络模型
+ 	$(PYTHON) scripts/train_model.py \
+ 		--config $(CONFIG) \
+ 		--data-dir $(DATA_DIR)/processed \
+ 		--output-dir $(OUTPUT_DIR)
+ 
+ train-mamba: ## 使用 Mamba 编码器训练
+ 	$(PYTHON) scripts/train_model.py \
+ 		--config configs/model/mamba.yaml \
+ 		--data-dir $(DATA_DIR)/processed \
+ 		--output-dir $(OUTPUT_DIR)/mamba
+ 
+ train-transformer: ## 使用 Transformer 编码器训练
+ 	$(PYTHON) scripts/train_model.py \
+ 		--config configs/model/transformer.yaml \
+ 		--data-dir $(DATA_DIR)/processed \
+ 		--output-dir $(OUTPUT_DIR)/transformer
+ 
+ baseline: ## 拟合岭回归基线
+ 	$(PYTHON) scripts/fit_baseline.py \
+ 		--config $(CONFIG) \
+ 		--data-dir $(DATA_DIR)/processed \
+ 		--output-dir $(OUTPUT_DIR)/baseline
+ 
+ eval: ## 评估模型
+ 	$(PYTHON) scripts/train_model.py \
+ 		--config $(CONFIG) \
+ 		--checkpoint $(CHECKPOINT) \
+ 		--data-dir $(DATA_DIR)/processed \
+ 		--eval-only
+ 
+ # ============================================================================
+ # 推理与可视化
+ # ============================================================================
+ 
+ infer: ## 运行推理
+ 	$(PYTHON) scripts/infer.py \
+ 		--config $(CONFIG) \
+ 		--checkpoint $(CHECKPOINT) \
+ 		--input $(INPUT) \
+ 		--output $(OUTPUT_DIR)/predictions
+ 
+ export-mesh: ## 导出 3D 网格
+ 	$(PYTHON) scripts/export_mesh.py \
+ 		--config $(CONFIG) \
+ 		--checkpoint $(CHECKPOINT) \
+ 		--input $(INPUT) \
+ 		--output $(OUTPUT_DIR)/meshes
+ 
+ viz: ## 可视化结果
+ 	$(PYTHON) -c "from plate_recon.viz import plots; plots.demo()"

@@ -1,undefined +1,313 @@
+ # plate-fbg-shape-recon
+ 
+ 基于 FBG（光纤布拉格光栅）传感器的板形状重建系统。
+ 
+ ## 📋 项目概述
+ 
+ ### 目标
+ 
+ - **输入**：上下表面各 1 根光纤（路径固定、FBG 点/采样点沿弧长）、网格 50mm、y∈[1,1.3] 为夹持区不可布线
+ - **处理**：上下表面应变对齐 → 做差得到 κₜ(s) = Δεₜ(s)/h → 映射到 (xᵢ, yᵢ, tₓ,ᵢ, tᵧ,ᵢ)
+ - **输出**：整板挠度场 w(x,y)（网格或连续场），并可导出 3D 曲面
+ 
+ ### 核心算法
+ 
+ #### 二维基展开（硬边界门函数 + DCT）
+ 
+ 挠度表示：
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ w(x,y) = g(ȳ) Σₘₙ aₘₙ φₘₙ(x̄,ȳ),  g(ȳ) = (1-ȳ)²
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 曲率张量：∇²w = {wₓₓ, wₓᵧ, wᵧᵧ}
+ 
+ 测量算子（可微）：
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ κₜ(i) = tₓ,ᵢ² wₓₓ(xᵢ,yᵢ) + 2tₓ,ᵢtᵧ,ᵢ wₓᵧ(xᵢ,yᵢ) + tᵧ,ᵢ² wᵧᵧ(xᵢ,yᵢ)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### 两套方法
+ 
+ 1. **岭回归/最小二乘基线**：给定系数线性关系 Aa ≈ κ，求解 min_a ‖Aa-κ‖² + λ‖Wa‖²
+ 2. **神经网络**：序列编码器 → 系数 head → 物理测量一致性 loss
+ 
+ ## 🚀 快速开始
+ 
+ ### 安装
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 克隆仓库
+ git clone https://github.com/misaka/plate-fbg-shape-recon.git
+ cd plate-fbg-shape-recon
+ 
+ # 方式1：使用 Makefile（推荐）
+ make setup
+ source .venv/bin/activate
+ 
+ # 方式2：手动安装
+ pip install -e ".[dev]"
+ 
+ # 安装可选依赖（Mamba SSM、3D可视化）
+ pip install -e ".[dev,mamba,viz]"
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 数据格式
+ 
+ 单条样本（一个工况/一个时间帧）存储为 HDF5 或 NPZ，字段固定：
+ 
+ | 字段 | 形状 | 说明 |
+ |------|------|------|
+ | &#96;fiber_s&#96; | (L,) | 弧长采样点（重采样后） |
+ | &#96;xy&#96; | (L, 2) | 对应点坐标 (x, y)，单位 m |
+ | &#96;tangent&#96; | (L, 2) | 切线 (tₓ, tᵧ) |
+ | &#96;eps_top&#96; | (L,) | 上表面沿切线应变 |
+ | &#96;eps_bot&#96; | (L,) | 下表面沿切线应变 |
+ | &#96;kappa_t&#96; | (L,) | = (eps_bot - eps_top) / h |
+ | &#96;mask&#96; | (L,) | 0/1 有效点标记 |
+ | &#96;w_gt&#96; | (Ny, Nx) 或 (N, 3) | 可选，真值挠度/网格 |
+ 
+ **元信息**：W（宽度）, L（长度）, h（厚度）, grid_dx=0.05, y_clamp=1.0
+ 
+ **标准化约定**：
+ - 坐标归一化：x_norm = x/W, y_norm = y/L
+ - κₜ 标准化：训练集均值方差
+ - y ∈ [1, 1.3] 区域：不进入数据点；边界 y=1.0 作为夹持线
+ 
+ ### 数据预处理
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 预处理原始数据
+ make preprocess DATA_DIR=data
+ 
+ # 或直接运行脚本
+ python scripts/preprocess_data.py \
+     --config configs/default.yaml \
+     --input-dir data/raw \
+     --output-dir data/processed
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 训练
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 训练神经网络模型（默认配置）
+ make train
+ 
+ # 使用 Mamba 编码器
+ make train-mamba
+ 
+ # 使用 Transformer 编码器
+ make train-transformer
+ 
+ # 自定义配置
+ python scripts/train_model.py \
+     --config configs/model/mamba.yaml \
+     --data-dir data/processed \
+     --output-dir outputs/experiment1
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 基线方法
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 拟合岭回归基线
+ make baseline
+ 
+ # 或直接运行
+ python scripts/fit_baseline.py \
+     --config configs/default.yaml \
+     --data-dir data/processed \
+     --output-dir outputs/baseline
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 推理
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 单样本推理
+ python scripts/infer.py \
+     --config configs/default.yaml \
+     --checkpoint outputs/best.pt \
+     --input data/test/sample.npz \
+     --output outputs/predictions
+ 
+ # 批量推理
+ python scripts/infer.py \
+     --config configs/default.yaml \
+     --checkpoint outputs/best.pt \
+     --input data/test/ \
+     --output outputs/predictions \
+     --batch
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 可视化
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 绘制结果
+ python -c "from plate_recon.viz import plots; plots.demo()"
+ 
+ # 导出 3D 网格
+ python scripts/export_mesh.py \
+     --config configs/default.yaml \
+     --checkpoint outputs/best.pt \
+     --input data/test/sample.npz \
+     --output outputs/meshes/sample.stl
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 评估
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 评估模型
+ make eval CHECKPOINT=outputs/best.pt
+ 
+ # 详细评估
+ python scripts/train_model.py \
+     --config configs/default.yaml \
+     --checkpoint outputs/best.pt \
+     --data-dir data/processed \
+     --eval-only \
+     --save-predictions
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 📁 项目结构
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ plate-fbg-shape-recon/
+ ├── README.md                    # 本文件
+ ├── pyproject.toml               # 项目配置与依赖
+ ├── Makefile                     # 常用命令
+ ├── .gitignore                   # Git 忽略规则
+ │
+ ├── configs/                     # 配置文件
+ │   ├── default.yaml             # 默认配置
+ │   ├── model/
+ │   │   ├── mamba.yaml           # Mamba 编码器配置
+ │   │   └── transformer.yaml     # Transformer 编码器配置
+ │   ├── basis/

+ │   │   └── spline.yaml          # 样条基配置
+ │   ├── data/

+ │   ├── train.yaml               # 训练配置
+ │   └── eval.yaml                # 评估配置
+ │
+ ├── plate_recon/                 # 核心库
+ │   ├── __init__.py              # 公共 API

+ │   │
+ │   ├── data/                    # 数据处理
+ │   │   ├── io.py                # 数据读写
+ │   │   ├── preprocess.py        # 预处理
+ │   │   ├── align.py             # 上下表面对齐
+ │   │   ├── dataset.py           # PyTorch Dataset
+ │   │   └── transforms.py        # 数据增强
+ │   │
+ │   ├── geometry/                # 几何计算
+ │   │   ├── path.py              # s-&gt;(x,y), 切线, 重采样
+ │   │   ├── grid.py              # 50mm 网格工具
+ │   │   └── normalize.py         # 坐标归一化
+ │   │
+ │   ├── basis/                   # 基函数
+ │   │   ├── dct2.py              # 2D DCT/傅里叶基 + 导数
+ │   │   ├── spline2.py           # 2D 样条基（可选）
+ │   │   ├── bc.py                # 硬边界门函数 g(y)
+ │   │   └── projection.py        # 从全场 w 拟合系数
+ │   │
+ │   ├── physics/                 # 物理模型
+ │   │   ├── curvature.py         # wₓₓ, wₓᵧ, wᵧᵧ 计算
+ │   │   ├── measurement.py       # 系数 → w → κₜ 测量算子
+ │   │   └── losses.py            # Huber, 高频正则, BC loss
+ │   │
+ │   ├── models/                  # 神经网络
+ │   │   ├── encoders/
+ │   │   │   ├── mamba_encoder.py      # Mamba SSM 编码器
+ │   │   │   └── transformer_encoder.py # Transformer 编码器
+ │   │   ├── heads/

+ │   │   └── plate_model.py            # 端到端模型
+ │   │
+ │   ├── baselines/               # 基线方法
+ │   │   ├── ridge_fit.py         # Tikhonov/岭回归
+ │   │   └── metrics.py           # 评估指标
+ │   │
+ │   ├── train/                   # 训练工具
+ │   │   ├── train.py             # 训练循环
+ │   │   ├── eval.py              # 评估
+ │   │   ├── callbacks.py         # 回调函数
+ │   │   └── logger.py            # 日志记录
+ │   │
+ │   └── viz/                     # 可视化
+ │       ├── plots.py             # 2D 绘图
+ │       └── render3d.py          # 3D 渲染
+ │
+ ├── scripts/                     # 入口脚本
+ │   ├── preprocess_data.py       # 数据预处理
+ │   ├── fit_baseline.py          # 基线拟合
+ │   ├── train_model.py           # 模型训练
+ │   ├── infer.py                 # 推理
+ │   └── export_mesh.py           # 导出网格
+ │
+ └── tests/                       # 单元测试
+     ├── test_basis_derivatives.py      # 基函数导数测试
+     ├── test_measurement_operator.py   # 测量算子测试
+     ├── test_alignment.py              # 对齐测试
+     └── test_ridge_baseline.py         # 岭回归测试
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 🔧 配置系统
+ 
+ 项目使用 Hydra 进行配置管理，支持配置组合与命令行覆盖：
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 使用默认配置
+ python scripts/train_model.py
+ 
+ # 覆盖配置
+ python scripts/train_model.py model=mamba basis=dct train.lr=1e-4
+ 
+ # 多运行
+ python scripts/train_model.py -m model=mamba,transformer basis=dct,spline
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 📊 损失函数
+ 
+ 默认损失函数组合：
+ 
+ - **L_κ**：Huber(κ_pred - κ_meas)，mask 加权
+ - **L_HF**：高频系数惩罚（随 m,n 增大权重增大）
+ - **L_BC**：边界条件损失（若未完全硬编码）
+ - **L_w**：有真值时的挠度场损失
+ 
+ ## 🧪 测试
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 运行所有测试
+ make test
+ 
+ # 快速测试
+ make test-fast
+ 
+ # 特定模块测试
+ make test-basis
+ make test-measurement
+ make test-alignment
+ make test-baseline
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 📈 评估指标
+ 
+ - **w 场误差**：RMSE, MAE, 相对误差
+ - **κₜ 一致性**：预测 κₜ 与测量 κₜ 的匹配度
+ - **边界误差**：夹持边界处的 w 和 ∂w/∂n
+ - **噪声鲁棒性**：不同噪声水平下的性能
+

+ # =============================================================================
+ # plate-fbg-shape-recon 默认配置
+ # =============================================================================
+ 
+ defaults:
+   - model: mamba
+   - basis: dct
+   - data: schema
+   - _self_
+ 
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 板几何参数
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ plate:
+   width: 0.3          # W: 板宽度 (m)
+   length: 1.3         # L: 板长度 (m)
+   thickness: 0.002    # h: 板厚度 (m)
+   grid_dx: 0.05       # 网格间距 (m), 50mm
+   y_clamp: 1.0        # 夹持边界 y 坐标 (m)
+   y_clamp_end: 1.3    # 夹持区结束 y 坐标 (m)
+ 
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 光纤参数
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ fiber:
+   num_points: 100     # 重采样点数
+   resample_method: "uniform"  # uniform, adaptive
+   
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 基函数配置
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ basis:
+   type: "dct"         # dct, spline
+   num_modes_x: 16     # x 方向模态数
+   num_modes_y: 24     # y 方向模态数
+   use_hard_bc: true   # 使用硬边界门函数
+   
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 模型配置
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ model:
+   encoder: "mamba"    # mamba, transformer
+   hidden_dim: 256
+   num_layers: 4
+   dropout: 0.1
+   
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 训练配置
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ train:
+   epochs: 200
+   batch_size: 32
+   lr: 1e-3
+   weight_decay: 1e-4
+   scheduler: "cosine"
+   warmup_epochs: 10
+   grad_clip: 1.0
+   
+   # 损失权重
+   loss:
+     kappa_weight: 1.0       # κ 一致性损失
+     hf_weight: 0.01         # 高频正则化
+     bc_weight: 0.1          # 边界条件损失
+     w_weight: 1.0           # 挠度场损失（有真值时）
+     huber_delta: 0.1        # Huber 损失 delta
+     
+   # 早停
+   early_stopping:
+     patience: 20
+     min_delta: 1e-6
+     
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 评估配置
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ eval:
+   metrics:
+     - rmse
+     - mae
+     - relative_error
+     - kappa_consistency
+     - bc_error
+   save_predictions: true
+   
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 数据配置
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ data:
+   train_split: 0.8
+   val_split: 0.1
+   test_split: 0.1
+   normalize: true
+   augment: false
+   
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 基线配置
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ baseline:
+   method: "ridge"     # ridge, lstsq
+   lambda_reg: 1e-4    # 正则化系数
+   hf_penalty: true    # 高频惩罚
+   
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 输出配置
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ output:
+   dir: "outputs"
+   save_every: 10
+   log_every: 100
+   
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ # 设备配置
+ # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ device: "cuda"        # cuda, cpu
+ seed: 42
+ num_workers: 4

+ # =============================================================================
+ # 2D DCT (离散余弦变换) 基函数配置
+ # =============================================================================
+ 
+ basis:
+   type: "dct"
+   
+   # 模态数
+   num_modes_x: 16       # x 方向模态数 (m = 0, 1, ..., M-1)
+   num_modes_y: 24       # y 方向模态数 (n = 0, 1, ..., N-1)
+   
+   # 基函数类型
+   # DCT-II: φ_mn(x,y) = cos(mπx̄) * cos(nπȳ)
+   # 其中 x̄ = x/W, ȳ = y/L (归一化坐标)
+   basis_type: "dct2"
+   
+   # 硬边界条件
+   hard_bc:
+     enabled: true
+     # 门函数 g(ȳ) = (1 - ȳ)^p，在 ȳ=1 处为零
+     gate_function: "polynomial"
+     gate_power: 2       # p = 2: g(ȳ) = (1-ȳ)²
+     
+   # 导数计算
+   derivatives:
+     method: "analytical"  # analytical, numerical
+     # 解析导数:
+     # ∂²φ/∂x² = -(mπ/W)² φ
+     # ∂²φ/∂y² = -(nπ/L)² φ
+     # ∂²φ/∂x∂y = (mπ/W)(nπ/L) sin(mπx̄) sin(nπȳ)
+     
+   # 高频惩罚权重
+   hf_penalty:
+     enabled: true
+     # 权重 w_mn = (m² + n²)^α
+     alpha: 1.0
+     normalize: true
  
```

</details>

</tool-use>

+ # =============================================================================
+ # 训练配置
+ # =============================================================================
+ 
+ train:
+   # 基本参数
+   epochs: 200
+   batch_size: 32
+   accumulate_grad_batches: 1
+   
+   # 优化器
+   optimizer:
+     type: "adamw"
+     lr: 1e-3
+     weight_decay: 1e-4
+     betas: [0.9, 0.999]
+     eps: 1e-8
+     
+   # 学习率调度
+   scheduler:
+     type: "cosine"        # cosine, step, plateau, onecycle
+     warmup_epochs: 10
+     min_lr: 1e-6
+     
+     # step scheduler
+     step_size: 50
+     gamma: 0.5
+     
+     # plateau scheduler
+     patience: 10
+     factor: 0.5
+     
+   # 梯度裁剪
+   grad_clip:
+     enabled: true
+     max_norm: 1.0
+     
+   # 损失函数
+   loss:
+     # κ 一致性损失 (主损失)
+     kappa:
+       type: "huber"       # huber, mse, mae
+       weight: 1.0
+       delta: 0.1          # Huber delta
+       
+     # 高频正则化
+     hf_reg:
+       enabled: true
+       weight: 0.01
+       alpha: 1.0          # 权重指数
+       
+     # 边界条件损失
+     bc:
+       enabled: true
+       weight: 0.1
+       # 惩罚 w(y=1) 和 ∂w/∂y(y=1)
+       
+     # 挠度场损失 (有真值时)
+     w_field:
+       enabled: true
+       weight: 1.0
+       type: "mse"
+       
+   # 早停
+   early_stopping:
+     enabled: true
+     monitor: "val/loss"
+     patience: 20
+     min_delta: 1e-6
+     mode: "min"
+     
+   # 检查点
+   checkpoint:
+     save_top_k: 3
+     monitor: "val/loss"
+     mode: "min"
+     save_last: true
+     
+   # 数据增强
+   augmentation:
+     enabled: false
+     noise_std: 0.001      # 应变噪声
+     dropout_prob: 0.05    # 随机丢点
+     
+ # 验证
+ val:
+   every_n_epochs: 1
+   
+ # 日志
+ logging:
+   backend: "tensorboard"  # tensorboard, wandb
+   log_every_n_steps: 100
+   
+ # 设备
+ device: "cuda"
+ precision: 32             # 16, 32, bf16
+ seed: 42
+ deterministic: false
+ num_workers: 4
  
```

@@ -1,undefined +1,185 @@
+ """
+ 类型定义模块
+ 
+ 定义项目中使用的核心数据类型和配置类。
+ """
+ 
+ from __future__ import annotations
+ 
+ from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+ from typing import Optional, Literal, Tuple
+ import numpy as np
+ import torch
+ from numpy.typing import NDArray
+ 
+ 
+ @dataclass
+ class PlateConfig:
+     """板几何配置
+     
+     Attributes:
+         width: 板宽度 W (m)
+         length: 板长度 L (m)
+         thickness: 板厚度 h (m)
+         grid_dx: 网格间距 (m)
+         y_clamp: 夹持边界 y 坐标 (m)
+         y_clamp_end: 夹持区结束 y 坐标 (m)
+     """
+     width: float = 0.3
+     length: float = 1.3
+     thickness: float = 0.002
+     grid_dx: float = 0.05
+     y_clamp: float = 1.0
+     y_clamp_end: float = 1.3
+     
+     @property
+     def num_grid_x(self) -&gt; int:
+         """x 方向网格点数"""
+         return int(self.width / self.grid_dx) + 1
+     
+     @property
+     def num_grid_y(self) -&gt; int:
+         """y 方向网格点数 (不含夹持区)"""
+         return int(self.y_clamp / self.grid_dx) + 1
+ 
+ 
+ @dataclass
+ class FiberSample:
+     """单条光纤样本数据
+     
+     存储一个工况/时间帧的光纤测量数据。
+     
+     Attributes:
+         fiber_s: 弧长采样点 (L,)
+         xy: 对应点坐标 (L, 2)，单位 m
+         tangent: 切线方向 (L, 2)，已归一化
+         eps_top: 上表面沿切线应变 (L,)
+         eps_bot: 下表面沿切线应变 (L,)
+         kappa_t: 切向曲率 (L,) = (eps_bot - eps_top) / h
+         mask: 有效点标记 (L,)
+         w_gt: 可选，真值挠度场 (Ny, Nx) 或点云 (N, 3)
+         metadata: 元信息字典
+     """
+     fiber_s: NDArray[np.float32]
+     xy: NDArray[np.float32]
+     tangent: NDArray[np.float32]
+     eps_top: NDArray[np.float32]
+     eps_bot: NDArray[np.float32]
+     kappa_t: NDArray[np.float32]
+     mask: NDArray[np.bool_]
+     w_gt: Optional[NDArray[np.float32]] = None
+     metadata: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
+     
+     def __post_init__(self):
+         """验证数据形状"""
+         L = len(self.fiber_s)
+         assert self.xy.shape == (L, 2), f"xy shape mismatch: {self.xy.shape}"
+         assert self.tangent.shape == (L, 2), f"tangent shape mismatch: {self.tangent.shape}"
+         assert self.eps_top.shape == (L,), f"eps_top shape mismatch: {self.eps_top.shape}"
+         assert self.eps_bot.shape == (L,), f"eps_bot shape mismatch: {self.eps_bot.shape}"
+         assert self.kappa_t.shape == (L,), f"kappa_t shape mismatch: {self.kappa_t.shape}"
+         assert self.mask.shape == (L,), f"mask shape mismatch: {self.mask.shape}"
+     
+     @property
+     def num_points(self) -&gt; int:
+         """采样点数"""
+         return len(self.fiber_s)
+     
+     @property
+     def num_valid(self) -&gt; int:
+         """有效点数"""
+         return int(self.mask.sum())
+     
+     def to_tensor(self, device: str = "cpu") -&gt; "FiberSampleTensor":
+         """转换为 PyTorch 张量"""
+         return FiberSampleTensor(
+             fiber_s=torch.from_numpy(self.fiber_s).to(device),
+             xy=torch.from_numpy(self.xy).to(device),
+             tangent=torch.from_numpy(self.tangent).to(device),
+             eps_top=torch.from_numpy(self.eps_top).to(device),
+             eps_bot=torch.from_numpy(self.eps_bot).to(device),
+             kappa_t=torch.from_numpy(self.kappa_t).to(device),
+             mask=torch.from_numpy(self.mask).to(device),
+             w_gt=torch.from_numpy(self.w_gt).to(device) if self.w_gt is not None else None,
+         )
+ 
+ 
+ @dataclass
+ class FiberSampleTensor:
+     """PyTorch 张量版本的光纤样本"""
+     fiber_s: torch.Tensor
+     xy: torch.Tensor
+     tangent: torch.Tensor
+     eps_top: torch.Tensor
+     eps_bot: torch.Tensor
+     kappa_t: torch.Tensor
+     mask: torch.Tensor
+     w_gt: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+ 
+ 
+ @dataclass
+ class BasisCoefficients:
+     """基函数系数
+     
+     Attributes:
+         coeffs: 系数数组 (M, N) 或展平 (M*N,)
+         num_modes_x: x 方向模态数 M
+         num_modes_y: y 方向模态数 N
+         basis_type: 基函数类型
+     """
+     coeffs: NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor
+     num_modes_x: int
+     num_modes_y: int
+     basis_type: Literal["dct", "spline"] = "dct"
+     
+     @property
+     def num_coeffs(self) -&gt; int:
+         """总系数数"""
+         return self.num_modes_x * self.num_modes_y
+     
+     def reshape_2d(self) -&gt; NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor:
+         """重塑为 2D 形状 (M, N)"""
+         if isinstance(self.coeffs, torch.Tensor):
+             return self.coeffs.reshape(self.num_modes_x, self.num_modes_y)
+         return self.coeffs.reshape(self.num_modes_x, self.num_modes_y)
+     
+     def flatten(self) -&gt; NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor:
+         """展平为 1D"""
+         if isinstance(self.coeffs, torch.Tensor):
+             return self.coeffs.flatten()
+         return self.coeffs.flatten()
+ 
+ 
+ @dataclass
+ class DeflectionField:
+     """挠度场
+     
+     Attributes:
+         w: 挠度值 (Ny, Nx)
+         x_grid: x 坐标网格 (Nx,)
+         y_grid: y 坐标网格 (Ny,)
+         w_xx: 可选，∂²w/∂x² (Ny, Nx)
+         w_xy: 可选，∂²w/∂x∂y (Ny, Nx)
+         w_yy: 可选，∂²w/∂y² (Ny, Nx)
+     """
+     w: NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor
+     x_grid: NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor
+     y_grid: NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor
+     w_xx: Optional[NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor] = None
+     w_xy: Optional[NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor] = None
+     w_yy: Optional[NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor] = None
+     
+     @property
+     def shape(self) -&gt; Tuple[int, int]:
+         """场形状 (Ny, Nx)"""
+         if isinstance(self.w, torch.Tensor):
+             return tuple(self.w.shape)
+         return self.w.shape
+     
+     def has_curvature(self) -&gt; bool:
+         """是否包含曲率信息"""
+         return self.w_xx is not None and self.w_xy is not None and self.w_yy is not None
+ 
+ 
+ # 类型别名
+ TensorOrArray = NDArray[np.float32] | torch.Tensor
  
```

+ def load_sample(

+     """加载单个样本

+

+ ) -&gt; None:

+     Args:
+         sample: FiberSample 对象
+         path: 保存路径
+         format: 文件格式 ("npz" 或 "hdf5")
+         compression: 是否压缩
+     """
+     path = Path(path)
+     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+     
+     if format == "npz":
+         _save_npz(sample, path, compression)
+     elif format in ["h5", "hdf5"]:
+         _save_hdf5(sample, path, compression)
+     else:
+         raise ValueError(f"不支持的格式: {format}")
+ 
+ 
+ def load_dataset(
+     data_dir: Union[str, Path],
+     pattern: str = "*.npz",
+     load_gt: bool = True,
+ ) -&gt; List[FiberSample]:
+     """加载数据集目录中的所有样本
+     
+     Args:

+         pattern: 文件匹配模式
+         load_gt: 是否加载真值
+         
+     Returns:
+         FiberSample 列表
+     """
+     data_dir = Path(data_dir)
+     files = sorted(data_dir.glob(pattern))
+     
+     samples = []
+     for f in files:
+         try:
+             sample = load_sample(f, load_gt)
+             samples.append(sample)
+         except Exception as e:

+ def _load_npz(path: Path, load_gt: bool) -&gt; FiberSample:

+     data = np.load(path, allow_pickle=True)
+

+         # 读取属性作为元信息

+ def _save_hdf5(sample: FiberSample, path: Path, compression: bool) -&gt; None:

+ """
+ 数据预处理模块
+ 
+ 包含原始数据清洗、格式转换、重采样等功能。
+ """
+ 
+ from __future__ import annotations
+ 
+ from typing import Optional, Tuple, Dict, Any
+ import numpy as np
+ from numpy.typing import NDArray
+ from scipy import interpolate
+ 
+ from plate_recon.types import FiberSample, PlateConfig
+ 
+ 
+ def preprocess_raw_data(
+     raw_data: Dict[str, Any],
+     config: PlateConfig,
+     num_resample: int = 100,
+     filter_clamp: bool = True,
+ ) -&gt; FiberSample:
+     """预处理原始数据
+     
+     执行以下步骤:
+     1. 提取并验证必需字段
+     2. 计算弧长参数化
+     3. 重采样到均匀弧长
+     4. 计算切线方向
+     5. 过滤夹持区点
+     6. 计算切向曲率 κₜ
+     
+     Args:
+         raw_data: 原始数据字典
+         config: 板配置
+         num_resample: 重采样点数
+         filter_clamp: 是否过滤夹持区
+         
+     Returns:
+         预处理后的 FiberSample
+     """
+     # 提取坐标和应变
+     x = np.asarray(raw_data["x"], dtype=np.float32)
+     y = np.asarray(raw_data["y"], dtype=np.float32)
+     eps_top = np.asarray(raw_data["eps_top"], dtype=np.float32)
+     eps_bot = np.asarray(raw_data["eps_bot"], dtype=np.float32)
+     
+     # 计算弧长
+     s = compute_arc_length(x, y)
+     
+     # 重采样
+     s_new, xy_new, tangent_new, eps_top_new, eps_bot_new = resample_fiber(
+         s, x, y, eps_top, eps_bot, num_resample
+     )
+     
+     # 创建掩码 (过滤夹持区)
+     if filter_clamp:
+         mask = xy_new[:, 1] &lt; config.y_clamp
+     else:
+         mask = np.ones(len(s_new), dtype=np.bool_)
+     
+     # 计算切向曲率
+     kappa_t = (eps_bot_new - eps_top_new) / config.thickness
+     
+     # 真值 (如果有)
+     w_gt = None
+     if "w_gt" in raw_data:
+         w_gt = np.asarray(raw_data["w_gt"], dtype=np.float32)
+     
+     # 元信息
+     metadata = {
+         "W": config.width,
+         "L": config.length,
+         "h": config.thickness,
+         "grid_dx": config.grid_dx,
+         "y_clamp": config.y_clamp,
+     }
+     
+     return FiberSample(
+         fiber_s=s_new,
+         xy=xy_new,
+         tangent=tangent_new,
+         eps_top=eps_top_new,
+         eps_bot=eps_bot_new,
+         kappa_t=kappa_t,
+         mask=mask,
+         w_gt=w_gt,
+         metadata=metadata,
+     )
+ 
+ 
+ def compute_arc_length(x: NDArray, y: NDArray) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """计算弧长参数
+     
+     Args:
+         x: x 坐标数组
+         y: y 坐标数组
+         
+     Returns:
+         弧长数组，从 0 开始
+     """
+     dx = np.diff(x)
+     dy = np.diff(y)
+     ds = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
+     s = np.zeros(len(x), dtype=np.float32)
+     s[1:] = np.cumsum(ds)
+     return s
+ 
+ 
+ def resample_fiber(
+     s: NDArray,
+     x: NDArray,
+     y: NDArray,
+     eps_top: NDArray,
+     eps_bot: NDArray,
+     num_points: int,
+ ) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray]:
+     """沿弧长均匀重采样光纤数据
+     
+     Args:
+         s: 原始弧长
+         x, y: 原始坐标
+         eps_top, eps_bot: 原始应变
+         num_points: 目标点数
+         
+     Returns:
+         (s_new, xy_new, tangent_new, eps_top_new, eps_bot_new)
+     """
+     # 新的均匀弧长
+     s_new = np.linspace(0, s[-1], num_points, dtype=np.float32)
+     
+     # 插值坐标
+     interp_x = interpolate.interp1d(s, x, kind="cubic", fill_value="extrapolate")
+     interp_y = interpolate.interp1d(s, y, kind="cubic", fill_value="extrapolate")
+     x_new = interp_x(s_new).astype(np.float32)
+     y_new = interp_y(s_new).astype(np.float32)
+     xy_new = np.stack([x_new, y_new], axis=-1)
+     
+     # 计算切线 (通过坐标对弧长的导数)
+     tangent_new = compute_tangent(s_new, x_new, y_new)
+     
+     # 插值应变
+     interp_eps_top = interpolate.interp1d(s, eps_top, kind="linear", fill_value="extrapolate")
+     interp_eps_bot = interpolate.interp1d(s, eps_bot, kind="linear", fill_value="extrapolate")
+     eps_top_new = interp_eps_top(s_new).astype(np.float32)
+     eps_bot_new = interp_eps_bot(s_new).astype(np.float32)
+     
+     return s_new, xy_new, tangent_new, eps_top_new, eps_bot_new
+ 
+ 
+ def compute_tangent(s: NDArray, x: NDArray, y: NDArray) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """计算切线方向
+     
+     使用中心差分计算，端点使用单侧差分。
+     
+     Args:
+         s: 弧长
+         x, y: 坐标
+         
+     Returns:
+         归一化切线 (N, 2)
+     """
+     n = len(s)
+     tangent = np.zeros((n, 2), dtype=np.float32)
+     
+     # 中心差分
+     for i in range(1, n - 1):
+         ds = s[i + 1] - s[i - 1]
+         tangent[i, 0] = (x[i + 1] - x[i - 1]) / ds
+         tangent[i, 1] = (y[i + 1] - y[i - 1]) / ds
+     
+     # 端点: 单侧差分
+     ds0 = s[1] - s[0]
+     tangent[0, 0] = (x[1] - x[0]) / ds0
+     tangent[0, 1] = (y[1] - y[0]) / ds0
+     
+     dsn = s[-1] - s[-2]
+     tangent[-1, 0] = (x[-1] - x[-2]) / dsn
+     tangent[-1, 1] = (y[-1] - y[-2]) / dsn
+     
+     # 归一化
+     norm = np.linalg.norm(tangent, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
+     tangent = tangent / (norm + 1e-8)
+     
+     return tangent
+ 
+ 
+ def filter_outliers(
+     data: NDArray,
+     method: str = "zscore",
+     threshold: float = 3.0,
+ ) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """过滤异常值
+     
+     Args:
+         data: 输入数据
+         method: 方法 ("zscore", "iqr")
+         threshold: 阈值
+         
+     Returns:
+         有效点掩码
+     """
+     if method == "zscore":
+         mean = np.mean(data)
+         std = np.std(data)
+         z = np.abs((data - mean) / (std + 1e-8))
+         return z &lt; threshold
+     elif method == "iqr":
+         q1, q3 = np.percentile(data, [25, 75])
+         iqr = q3 - q1
+         lower = q1 - threshold * iqr
+         upper = q3 + threshold * iqr
+         return (data &gt;= lower) &amp; (data &lt;= upper)
+     else:
+         raise ValueError(f"未知方法: {method}")
+ 
+ 
+ def smooth_strain(
+     strain: NDArray,
+     window_size: int = 5,
+     method: str = "savgol",
+ ) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """平滑应变数据
+     
+     Args:
+         strain: 应变数组
+         window_size: 窗口大小
+         method: 方法 ("savgol", "moving_avg")
+         
+     Returns:
+         平滑后的应变
+     """
+     from scipy.signal import savgol_filter
+     
+     if method == "savgol":
+         if window_size % 2 == 0:
+             window_size += 1
+         return savgol_filter(strain, window_size, polyorder=2).astype(np.float32)
+     elif method == "moving_avg":
+         kernel = np.ones(window_size) / window_size
+         return np.convolve(strain, kernel, mode="same").astype(np.float32)
+     else:
+         raise ValueError(f"未知方法: {method}")
  
```

+ """
+ 上下表面应变对齐模块
+ 
+ 处理上下表面光纤的空间对齐问题。
+ """
+ 
+ from __future__ import annotations
+ 
+ from typing import Tuple, Optional
+ import numpy as np
+ from numpy.typing import NDArray
+ from scipy import interpolate
+ from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
+ 
+ 
+ def align_top_bottom(
+     xy_top: NDArray,
+     xy_bot: NDArray,
+     eps_top: NDArray,
+     eps_bot: NDArray,
+     method: str = "interpolate",
+     reference: str = "top",
+ ) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray]:
+     """对齐上下表面应变数据
+     
+     由于上下表面光纤路径可能略有不同，需要将它们对齐到相同的空间位置。
+     
+     Args:
+         xy_top: 上表面坐标 (N_top, 2)
+         xy_bot: 下表面坐标 (N_bot, 2)
+         eps_top: 上表面应变 (N_top,)
+         eps_bot: 下表面应变 (N_bot,)
+         method: 对齐方法 ("interpolate", "nearest", "average")
+         reference: 参考表面 ("top", "bot", "common")
+         
+     Returns:
+         (xy_aligned, eps_top_aligned, eps_bot_aligned, mask)
+     """
+     if method == "interpolate":
+         return _align_interpolate(xy_top, xy_bot, eps_top, eps_bot, reference)
+     elif method == "nearest":
+         return _align_nearest(xy_top, xy_bot, eps_top, eps_bot, reference)
+     elif method == "average":
+         return _align_average(xy_top, xy_bot, eps_top, eps_bot)
+     else:
+         raise ValueError(f"未知对齐方法: {method}")
+ 
+ 
+ def _align_interpolate(
+     xy_top: NDArray,
+     xy_bot: NDArray,
+     eps_top: NDArray,
+     eps_bot: NDArray,
+     reference: str,
+ ) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray]:
+     """使用插值对齐
+     
+     将一个表面的数据插值到另一个表面的位置。
+     """
+     if reference == "top":
+         # 以上表面为参考，插值下表面
+         xy_ref = xy_top
+         eps_top_aligned = eps_top
+         
+         # 计算下表面弧长
+         s_bot = _compute_arc_length_2d(xy_bot)
+         s_ref = _compute_arc_length_2d(xy_ref)
+         
+         # 插值下表面应变到参考位置
+         interp = interpolate.interp1d(
+             s_bot, eps_bot, kind="linear", 
+             bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan
+         )
+         eps_bot_aligned = interp(s_ref).astype(np.float32)
+         
+     elif reference == "bot":
+         # 以下表面为参考
+         xy_ref = xy_bot
+         eps_bot_aligned = eps_bot
+         
+         s_top = _compute_arc_length_2d(xy_top)
+         s_ref = _compute_arc_length_2d(xy_ref)
+         
+         interp = interpolate.interp1d(
+             s_top, eps_top, kind="linear",
+             bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan
+         )
+         eps_top_aligned = interp(s_ref).astype(np.float32)
+         
+     else:  # common
+         # 创建公共网格
+         s_top = _compute_arc_length_2d(xy_top)
+         s_bot = _compute_arc_length_2d(xy_bot)
+         
+         s_max = min(s_top[-1], s_bot[-1])
+         n_points = max(len(xy_top), len(xy_bot))
+         s_ref = np.linspace(0, s_max, n_points, dtype=np.float32)
+         
+         # 插值两个表面
+         interp_x_top = interpolate.interp1d(s_top, xy_top[:, 0], kind="cubic")
+         interp_y_top = interpolate.interp1d(s_top, xy_top[:, 1], kind="cubic")
+         interp_eps_top = interpolate.interp1d(s_top, eps_top, kind="linear")
+         
+         interp_x_bot = interpolate.interp1d(s_bot, xy_bot[:, 0], kind="cubic")
+         interp_y_bot = interpolate.interp1d(s_bot, xy_bot[:, 1], kind="cubic")
+         interp_eps_bot = interpolate.interp1d(s_bot, eps_bot, kind="linear")
+         
+         # 取平均坐标
+         x_ref = (interp_x_top(s_ref) + interp_x_bot(s_ref)) / 2
+         y_ref = (interp_y_top(s_ref) + interp_y_bot(s_ref)) / 2
+         xy_ref = np.stack([x_ref, y_ref], axis=-1).astype(np.float32)
+         
+         eps_top_aligned = interp_eps_top(s_ref).astype(np.float32)
+         eps_bot_aligned = interp_eps_bot(s_ref).astype(np.float32)
+     
+     # 创建有效掩码
+     mask = ~(np.isnan(eps_top_aligned) | np.isnan(eps_bot_aligned))
+     
+     # 填充 NaN
+     eps_top_aligned = np.nan_to_num(eps_top_aligned, nan=0.0)
+     eps_bot_aligned = np.nan_to_num(eps_bot_aligned, nan=0.0)
+     
+     return xy_ref, eps_top_aligned, eps_bot_aligned, mask
+ 
+ 
+ def _align_nearest(
+     xy_top: NDArray,
+     xy_bot: NDArray,
+     eps_top: NDArray,
+     eps_bot: NDArray,
+     reference: str,
+ ) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray]:
+     """使用最近邻对齐"""
+     if reference == "top":
+         xy_ref = xy_top
+         eps_top_aligned = eps_top
+         
+         # 找最近邻
+         tree = cKDTree(xy_bot)
+         distances, indices = tree.query(xy_ref)
+         eps_bot_aligned = eps_bot[indices].astype(np.float32)
+         
+         # 距离过大的点标记为无效
+         max_dist = np.median(distances) * 3
+         mask = distances &lt; max_dist
+         
+     elif reference == "bot":
+         xy_ref = xy_bot
+         eps_bot_aligned = eps_bot
+         
+         tree = cKDTree(xy_top)
+         distances, indices = tree.query(xy_ref)
+         eps_top_aligned = eps_top[indices].astype(np.float32)
+         
+         max_dist = np.median(distances) * 3
+         mask = distances &lt; max_dist
+         
+     else:
+         raise ValueError("nearest 方法不支持 'common' 参考")
+     
+     return xy_ref, eps_top_aligned, eps_bot_aligned, mask
+ 
+ 
+ def _align_average(
+     xy_top: NDArray,
+     xy_bot: NDArray,
+     eps_top: NDArray,
+     eps_bot: NDArray,
+ ) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray]:
+     """使用平均位置对齐
+     
+     假设上下表面点数相同且一一对应。
+     """
+     if len(xy_top) != len(xy_bot):
+         raise ValueError("average 方法要求上下表面点数相同")
+     
+     xy_ref = ((xy_top + xy_bot) / 2).astype(np.float32)
+     mask = np.ones(len(xy_ref), dtype=np.bool_)
+     
+     return xy_ref, eps_top.astype(np.float32), eps_bot.astype(np.float32), mask
+ 
+ 
+ def _compute_arc_length_2d(xy: NDArray) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """计算 2D 路径的弧长"""
+     diff = np.diff(xy, axis=0)
+     ds = np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=1)
+     s = np.zeros(len(xy), dtype=np.float32)
+     s[1:] = np.cumsum(ds)
+     return s
+ 
+ 
+ def compute_kappa_from_aligned(
+     eps_top: NDArray,
+     eps_bot: NDArray,
+     thickness: float,
+     mask: Optional[NDArray] = None,
+ ) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """从对齐的应变计算切向曲率
+     
+     κₜ = (ε_bot - ε_top) / h
+     
+     Args:
+         eps_top: 上表面应变
+         eps_bot: 下表面应变
+         thickness: 板厚度 h
+         mask: 有效点掩码
+         
+     Returns:
+         切向曲率 κₜ
+     """
+     kappa_t = (eps_bot - eps_top) / thickness
+     
+     if mask is not None:
+         kappa_t = np.where(mask, kappa_t, 0.0)
+     
+     return kappa_t.astype(np.float32)
  
```

+ """
+ PyTorch Dataset 模块
+ 
+ 提供用于训练的 Dataset 类。
+ """
+ 
+ from __future__ import annotations
+ 
+ from pathlib import Path
+ from typing import Optional, Union, List, Dict, Any, Tuple

+ class PlateDataset(Dataset):
+     """板形状重建数据集
+     
+     加载预处理后的光纤数据，用于训练神经网络。
+     
+     Attributes:
+         samples: FiberSample 列表
+         normalize: 是否归一化
+         stats: 归一化统计量
+         transform: 数据变换
+     """
+     
+     def __init__(
+         self,
+         data_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
+         samples: Optional[List[FiberSample]] = None,
+         normalize: bool = True,
+         stats: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+         transform: Optional[callable] = None,
+         config: Optional[PlateConfig] = None,
+     ):
+         """初始化数据集
+         
+         Args:
+             data_dir: 数据目录（与 samples 二选一）
+             samples: 预加载的样本列表
+             normalize: 是否归一化
+             stats: 归一化统计量（如果为 None 则从数据计算）
+             transform: 数据变换函数
+             config: 板配置
+         """
+         if data_dir is not None:
+             self.samples = load_dataset(data_dir)
+         elif samples is not None:
+             self.samples = samples
+         else:
+             raise ValueError("必须提供 data_dir 或 samples")
+         
+         self.normalize = normalize
+         self.transform = transform
+         self.config = config or PlateConfig()
+         
+         # 计算或使用提供的统计量
+         if normalize:
+             if stats is not None:
+                 self.stats = stats
+             else:
+                 self.stats = self._compute_stats()
+         else:
+             self.stats = None
+     
+     def __len__(self) -&gt; int:
+         return len(self.samples)
+     
+     def __getitem__(self, idx: int) -&gt; Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+         """获取单个样本
+         
+         Returns:
+             字典包含:
+             - xy: 坐标 (L, 2)
+             - xy_norm: 归一化坐标 (L, 2)
+             - tangent: 切线 (L, 2)
+             - kappa_t: 切向曲率 (L,)
+             - mask: 有效掩码 (L,)
+             - w_gt: 真值挠度（如果有）
+         """
+         sample = self.samples[idx]
+         
+         # 基本数据
+         xy = torch.from_numpy(sample.xy)
+         tangent = torch.from_numpy(sample.tangent)
+         kappa_t = torch.from_numpy(sample.kappa_t)
+         mask = torch.from_numpy(sample.mask)
+         
+         # 归一化坐标
+         xy_norm = xy.clone()
+         xy_norm[:, 0] = xy[:, 0] / self.config.width
+         xy_norm[:, 1] = xy[:, 1] / self.config.length
+         
+         # 归一化 kappa_t
+         if self.normalize and self.stats is not None:
+             kappa_t_norm = (kappa_t - self.stats["kappa_mean"]) / (self.stats["kappa_std"] + 1e-8)
+         else:
+             kappa_t_norm = kappa_t
+         
+         result = {
+             "xy": xy,
+             "xy_norm": xy_norm,
+             "tangent": tangent,
+             "kappa_t": kappa_t,
+             "kappa_t_norm": kappa_t_norm,
+             "mask": mask,
+             "fiber_s": torch.from_numpy(sample.fiber_s),
+         }
+         
+         # 真值
+         if sample.w_gt is not None:
+             result["w_gt"] = torch.from_numpy(sample.w_gt)
+         
+         # 应用变换
+         if self.transform is not None:
+             result = self.transform(result)
+         
+         return result
+     
+     def _compute_stats(self) -&gt; Dict[str, float]:
+         """计算归一化统计量"""
+         all_kappa = []
+         for sample in self.samples:
+             valid_kappa = sample.kappa_t[sample.mask]
+             all_kappa.append(valid_kappa)
+         
+         all_kappa = np.concatenate(all_kappa)
+         
+         return {
+             "kappa_mean": float(np.mean(all_kappa)),
+             "kappa_std": float(np.std(all_kappa)),
+             "kappa_min": float(np.min(all_kappa)),
+             "kappa_max": float(np.max(all_kappa)),
+         }
+     
+     def get_stats(self) -&gt; Dict[str, float]:
+         """获取统计量"""
+         return self.stats
+     
+     @staticmethod
+     def collate_fn(batch: List[Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]) -&gt; Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+         """自定义批处理函数
+         
+         处理变长序列，进行填充。
+         """
+         # 找最大长度
+         max_len = max(item["xy"].shape[0] for item in batch)
+         
+         # 初始化批次张量
+         batch_size = len(batch)
+         result = {
+             "xy": torch.zeros(batch_size, max_len, 2),
+             "xy_norm": torch.zeros(batch_size, max_len, 2),
+             "tangent": torch.zeros(batch_size, max_len, 2),
+             "kappa_t": torch.zeros(batch_size, max_len),
+             "kappa_t_norm": torch.zeros(batch_size, max_len),
+             "mask": torch.zeros(batch_size, max_len, dtype=torch.bool),
+             "fiber_s": torch.zeros(batch_size, max_len),
+             "lengths": torch.zeros(batch_size, dtype=torch.long),
+         }
+         
+         # 填充
+         for i, item in enumerate(batch):
+             L = item["xy"].shape[0]
+             result["xy"][i, :L] = item["xy"]
+             result["xy_norm"][i, :L] = item["xy_norm"]
+             result["tangent"][i, :L] = item["tangent"]
+             result["kappa_t"][i, :L] = item["kappa_t"]
+             result["kappa_t_norm"][i, :L] = item["kappa_t_norm"]
+             result["mask"][i, :L] = item["mask"]
+             result["fiber_s"][i, :L] = item["fiber_s"]
+             result["lengths"][i] = L
+         
+         # 真值（如果有）
+         if "w_gt" in batch[0]:
+             # 假设所有真值形状相同
+             w_gt_list = [item["w_gt"] for item in batch]
+             result["w_gt"] = torch.stack(w_gt_list)
+         
+         return result
+ 
+ 
+ def create_dataloaders(
+     data_dir: Union[str, Path],
+     batch_size: int = 32,
+     train_split: float = 0.8,
+     val_split: float = 0.1,
+     num_workers: int = 4,
+     seed: int = 42,
+     **kwargs,
+ ) -&gt; Tuple[DataLoader, DataLoader, DataLoader]:
+     """创建训练/验证/测试数据加载器
+     
+     Args:
+         data_dir: 数据目录
+         batch_size: 批大小
+         train_split: 训练集比例
+         val_split: 验证集比例
+         num_workers: 工作进程数
+         seed: 随机种子
+         
+     Returns:
+         (train_loader, val_loader, test_loader)
+     """
+     # 加载所有样本
+     all_samples = load_dataset(data_dir)
+     n_total = len(all_samples)
+     
+     # 划分
+     np.random.seed(seed)
+     indices = np.random.permutation(n_total)
+     
+     n_train = int(n_total * train_split)
+     n_val = int(n_total * val_split)
+     
+     train_indices = indices[:n_train]
+     val_indices = indices[n_train:n_train + n_val]
+     test_indices = indices[n_train + n_val:]
+     
+     train_samples = [all_samples[i] for i in train_indices]
+     val_samples = [all_samples[i] for i in val_indices]
+     test_samples = [all_samples[i] for i in test_indices]
+     
+     # 创建数据集（使用训练集统计量）
+     train_dataset = PlateDataset(samples=train_samples, normalize=True, **kwargs)
+     stats = train_dataset.get_stats()
+     
+     val_dataset = PlateDataset(samples=val_samples, normalize=True, stats=stats, **kwargs)
+     test_dataset = PlateDataset(samples=test_samples, normalize=True, stats=stats, **kwargs)
+     
+     # 创建加载器
+     train_loader = DataLoader(
+         train_dataset,
+         batch_size=batch_size,
+         shuffle=True,
+         num_workers=num_workers,
+         collate_fn=PlateDataset.collate_fn,
+         pin_memory=True,
+     )
+     
+     val_loader = DataLoader(
+         val_dataset,
+         batch_size=batch_size,
+         shuffle=False,
+         num_workers=num_workers,
+         collate_fn=PlateDataset.collate_fn,
+         pin_memory=True,
+     )
+     
+     test_loader = DataLoader(
+         test_dataset,
+         batch_size=batch_size,
+         shuffle=False,
+         num_workers=num_workers,
+         collate_fn=PlateDataset.collate_fn,
+         pin_memory=True,
+     )
+     
+     return train_loader, val_loader, test_loader

+ """
+ 数据变换模块
+ 
+ 提供数据增强和变换功能。
+ """
+ 
+ from __future__ import annotations
+ 
+ from typing import Dict, Optional
+ import torch
+ import numpy as np
+ 
+ 
+ class Compose:
+     """组合多个变换"""
+     
+     def __init__(self, transforms: list):
+         self.transforms = transforms
+     
+     def __call__(self, data: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -&gt; Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+         for t in self.transforms:
+             data = t(data)
+         return data
+ 
+ 
+ class AddNoise:
+     """添加高斯噪声
+     
+     模拟测量噪声，增强模型鲁棒性。
+     """
+     
+     def __init__(
+         self,
+         kappa_std: float = 0.001,
+         xy_std: float = 0.0001,
+         prob: float = 0.5,
+     ):
+         """
+         Args:
+             kappa_std: κₜ 噪声标准差
+             xy_std: 坐标噪声标准差 (m)
+             prob: 应用概率
+         """
+         self.kappa_std = kappa_std
+         self.xy_std = xy_std
+         self.prob = prob
+     
+     def __call__(self, data: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -&gt; Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+         if torch.rand(1).item() &gt; self.prob:
+             return data
+         
+         # 添加 κₜ 噪声
+         if self.kappa_std &gt; 0:
+             noise = torch.randn_like(data["kappa_t"]) * self.kappa_std
+             data["kappa_t"] = data["kappa_t"] + noise * data["mask"].float()
+             
+             # 同步更新归一化版本
+             if "kappa_t_norm" in data:
+                 data["kappa_t_norm"] = data["kappa_t_norm"] + noise * data["mask"].float()
+         
+         # 添加坐标噪声
+         if self.xy_std &gt; 0:
+             noise = torch.randn_like(data["xy"]) * self.xy_std
+             data["xy"] = data["xy"] + noise
+         
+         return data
+ 
+ 
+ class RandomDropout:
+     """随机丢弃采样点
+     
+     模拟传感器故障或数据缺失。
+     """
+     
+     def __init__(self, dropout_prob: float = 0.05, min_keep: int = 10):
+         """
+         Args:
+             dropout_prob: 丢弃概率
+             min_keep: 最少保留点数
+         """
+         self.dropout_prob = dropout_prob
+         self.min_keep = min_keep
+     
+     def __call__(self, data: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -&gt; Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+         mask = data["mask"]
+         n_valid = mask.sum().item()
+         
+         if n_valid &lt;= self.min_keep:
+             return data
+         
+         # 随机丢弃
+         drop_mask = torch.rand_like(mask.float()) &lt; self.dropout_prob
+         new_mask = mask &amp; ~drop_mask
+         
+         # 确保保留足够点
+         if new_mask.sum() &lt; self.min_keep:
+             return data
+         
+         data["mask"] = new_mask
+         return data
+ 
+ 
+ class RandomScale:
+     """随机缩放 κₜ
+     
+     模拟不同载荷大小。
+     """
+     
+     def __init__(self, scale_range: tuple = (0.8, 1.2), prob: float = 0.3):
+         self.scale_range = scale_range
+         self.prob = prob
+     
+     def __call__(self, data: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -&gt; Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+         if torch.rand(1).item() &gt; self.prob:
+             return data
+         
+         scale = torch.empty(1).uniform_(*self.scale_range).item()
+         data["kappa_t"] = data["kappa_t"] * scale
+         
+         if "kappa_t_norm" in data:
+             data["kappa_t_norm"] = data["kappa_t_norm"] * scale
+         
+         if "w_gt" in data:
+             data["w_gt"] = data["w_gt"] * scale
+         
+         return data
+ 
+ 
+ class Normalize:
+     """归一化变换"""
+     
+     def __init__(
+         self,
+         kappa_mean: float = 0.0,
+         kappa_std: float = 1.0,
+         width: float = 0.3,
+         length: float = 1.3,
+     ):
+         self.kappa_mean = kappa_mean
+         self.kappa_std = kappa_std
+         self.width = width
+         self.length = length
+     
+     def __call__(self, data: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -&gt; Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+         # 归一化坐标
+         data["xy_norm"] = data["xy"].clone()
+         data["xy_norm"][:, 0] = data["xy"][:, 0] / self.width
+         data["xy_norm"][:, 1] = data["xy"][:, 1] / self.length
+         
+         # 归一化 κₜ
+         data["kappa_t_norm"] = (data["kappa_t"] - self.kappa_mean) / (self.kappa_std + 1e-8)
+         
+         return data
+ 
+ 
+ def get_train_transforms(
+     noise_std: float = 0.001,
+     dropout_prob: float = 0.05,
+ ) -&gt; Compose:
+     """获取训练时的数据变换"""
+     return Compose([
+         AddNoise(kappa_std=noise_std, prob=0.5),
+         RandomDropout(dropout_prob=dropout_prob),
+         RandomScale(scale_range=(0.9, 1.1), prob=0.3),
+     ])
+ 
+ 
+ def get_eval_transforms() -&gt; Optional[Compose]:
+     """获取评估时的数据变换（通常为 None）"""
+     return None
  
```

+ """
+ 光纤路径几何模块
+ 
+ 处理光纤路径的参数化、切线计算、重采样等。
+ """
+ 
+ from __future__ import annotations
+ 
+ from typing import Tuple, Optional, Callable
+ import numpy as np
+ from numpy.typing import NDArray
+ from scipy import interpolate
+ 
+ 
+ class FiberPath:
+     """光纤路径类
+     
+     提供路径的参数化表示和相关几何计算。
+     
+     Attributes:
+         x: x 坐标数组
+         y: y 坐标数组
+         s: 弧长参数
+     """
+     
+     def __init__(self, x: NDArray, y: NDArray):
+         """初始化光纤路径
+         
+         Args:
+             x: x 坐标数组
+             y: y 坐标数组
+         """
+         self.x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float32)
+         self.y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float32)
+         self.s = self._compute_arc_length()
+         
+         # 创建插值器
+         self._interp_x = interpolate.CubicSpline(self.s, self.x)
+         self._interp_y = interpolate.CubicSpline(self.s, self.y)
+     
+     def _compute_arc_length(self) -&gt; NDArray:
+         """计算弧长参数"""
+         dx = np.diff(self.x)
+         dy = np.diff(self.y)
+         ds = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
+         s = np.zeros(len(self.x), dtype=np.float32)
+         s[1:] = np.cumsum(ds)
+         return s
+     
+     @property
+     def total_length(self) -&gt; float:
+         """路径总长度"""
+         return float(self.s[-1])
+     
+     @property
+     def num_points(self) -&gt; int:
+         """原始点数"""
+         return len(self.x)
+     
+     def evaluate(self, s: NDArray) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray]:
+         """在给定弧长处计算坐标
+         
+         Args:
+             s: 弧长参数数组
+             
+         Returns:
+             (x, y) 坐标
+         """
+         x = self._interp_x(s).astype(np.float32)
+         y = self._interp_y(s).astype(np.float32)
+         return x, y
+     
+     def tangent(self, s: NDArray) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray]:
+         """在给定弧长处计算切线方向
+         
+         切线 = (dx/ds, dy/ds)，已归一化。
+         
+         Args:
+             s: 弧长参数数组
+             
+         Returns:
+             (tx, ty) 归一化切线分量
+         """
+         # 使用样条导数
+         dx_ds = self._interp_x(s, 1)
+         dy_ds = self._interp_y(s, 1)
+         
+         # 归一化
+         norm = np.sqrt(dx_ds**2 + dy_ds**2)
+         tx = (dx_ds / (norm + 1e-8)).astype(np.float32)
+         ty = (dy_ds / (norm + 1e-8)).astype(np.float32)
+         
+         return tx, ty
+     
+     def curvature(self, s: NDArray) -&gt; NDArray:
+         """在给定弧长处计算曲率
+         
+         曲率 κ = |x'y'' - y'x''| / (x'² + y'²)^(3/2)
+         
+         Args:
+             s: 弧长参数数组
+             
+         Returns:
+             曲率数组
+         """
+         dx = self._interp_x(s, 1)
+         dy = self._interp_y(s, 1)
+         ddx = self._interp_x(s, 2)
+         ddy = self._interp_y(s, 2)
+         
+         numerator = np.abs(dx * ddy - dy * ddx)
+         denominator = (dx**2 + dy**2) ** 1.5
+         
+         return (numerator / (denominator + 1e-8)).astype(np.float32)
+     
+     def resample(
+         self,
+         num_points: int,
+         method: str = "uniform",
+     ) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray]:
+         """重采样路径
+         
+         Args:
+             num_points: 目标点数
+             method: 采样方法 ("uniform", "adaptive")
+             
+         Returns:
+             (s_new, x_new, y_new, tx_new, ty_new)
+         """
+         if method == "uniform":
+             s_new = np.linspace(0, self.total_length, num_points, dtype=np.float32)
+         elif method == "adaptive":
+             s_new = self._adaptive_sampling(num_points)
+         else:
+             raise ValueError(f"未知采样方法: {method}")
+         
+         x_new, y_new = self.evaluate(s_new)
+         tx_new, ty_new = self.tangent(s_new)
+         
+         return s_new, x_new, y_new, tx_new, ty_new
+     
+     def _adaptive_sampling(self, num_points: int) -&gt; NDArray:
+         """自适应采样（曲率大的地方采样密集）"""
+         # 在均匀网格上计算曲率
+         s_uniform = np.linspace(0, self.total_length, 1000)
+         kappa = self.curvature(s_uniform)
+         
+         # 曲率加权的累积分布
+         weights = 1 + kappa / (np.max(kappa) + 1e-8)
+         cdf = np.cumsum(weights)
+         cdf = cdf / cdf[-1]
+         
+         # 反函数采样
+         target = np.linspace(0, 1, num_points)
+         s_new = np.interp(target, cdf, s_uniform).astype(np.float32)
+         
+         return s_new
+     
+     def to_xy_tangent(self, num_points: int = 100) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray]:
+         """转换为 (x, y, tx, ty) 格式
+         
+         Args:
+             num_points: 采样点数
+             
+         Returns:
+             (xy, tangent) 其中 xy: (N, 2), tangent: (N, 2)
+         """
+         s_new, x_new, y_new, tx_new, ty_new = self.resample(num_points)
+         
+         xy = np.stack([x_new, y_new], axis=-1)
+         tangent = np.stack([tx_new, ty_new], axis=-1)
+         
+         return xy, tangent
+ 
+ 
+ def create_serpentine_path(
+     width: float,
+     length: float,
+     num_passes: int = 5,
+     margin: float = 0.02,
+ ) -&gt; FiberPath:
+     """创建蛇形光纤路径
+     
+     常见的光纤布置方式，在板上来回穿梭。
+     
+     Args:
+         width: 板宽度
+         length: 板长度（不含夹持区）
+         num_passes: 来回次数
+         margin: 边缘距离
+         
+     Returns:
+         FiberPath 对象
+     """
+     points_per_pass = 50
+     x_list = []
+     y_list = []
+     
+     y_positions = np.linspace(margin, length - margin, num_passes)
+     
+     for i, y_pos in enumerate(y_positions):
+         if i % 2 == 0:
+             # 从左到右
+             x_pass = np.linspace(margin, width - margin, points_per_pass)
+         else:
+             # 从右到左
+             x_pass = np.linspace(width - margin, margin, points_per_pass)
+         
+         y_pass = np.full(points_per_pass, y_pos)
+         
+         x_list.extend(x_pass)
+         y_list.extend(y_pass)
+         
+         # 添加转弯段（除了最后一段）
+         if i &lt; len(y_positions) - 1:
+             y_turn = np.linspace(y_pos, y_positions[i + 1], 10)[1:-1]
+             x_turn = np.full(len(y_turn), x_pass[-1])
+             x_list.extend(x_turn)
+             y_list.extend(y_turn)
+     
+     return FiberPath(np.array(x_list), np.array(y_list))
+ 
+ 
+ def create_spiral_path(
+     width: float,
+     length: float,
+     num_turns: int = 3,
+     center: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None,
+ ) -&gt; FiberPath:
+     """创建螺旋光纤路径
+     
+     Args:
+         width: 板宽度
+         length: 板长度
+         num_turns: 螺旋圈数
+         center: 螺旋中心，默认为板中心
+         
+     Returns:
+         FiberPath 对象
+     """
+     if center is None:
+         center = (width / 2, length / 2)
+     
+     # 参数
+     num_points = num_turns * 100
+     theta = np.linspace(0, num_turns * 2 * np.pi, num_points)
+     
+     # 螺旋半径（从小到大）
+     r_max = min(width, length) / 2 * 0.9
+     r = np.linspace(0.01, r_max, num_points)
+     
+     x = center[0] + r * np.cos(theta)
+     y = center[1] + r * np.sin(theta)
+     
+     return FiberPath(x.astype(np.float32), y.astype(np.float32))
  
```

+ """
+ 网格工具模块
+ 
+ 处理 50mm 网格相关的计算。
+ """
+ 
+ from __future__ import annotations
+ 
+ from typing import Tuple, Optional
+ import numpy as np
+ from numpy.typing import NDArray
+ import torch
+ 
+ 
+ def create_grid(
+     width: float,
+     length: float,
+     dx: float = 0.05,
+     y_clamp: Optional[float] = None,
+ ) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray]:
+     """创建规则网格
+     
+     Args:
+         width: 板宽度 (m)
+         length: 板长度 (m)
+         dx: 网格间距 (m)，默认 50mm
+         y_clamp: 夹持边界 y 坐标，如果指定则只生成 y &lt; y_clamp 的网格
+         
+     Returns:
+         (x_1d, y_1d, X, Y) 其中 X, Y 是 meshgrid
+     """
+     if y_clamp is not None:
+         y_max = y_clamp
+     else:
+         y_max = length
+     
+     x_1d = np.arange(0, width + dx/2, dx, dtype=np.float32)
+     y_1d = np.arange(0, y_max + dx/2, dx, dtype=np.float32)
+     
+     X, Y = np.meshgrid(x_1d, y_1d, indexing='xy')
+     
+     return x_1d, y_1d, X, Y
+ 
+ 
+ def create_normalized_grid(
+     num_x: int,
+     num_y: int,
+ ) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray, NDArray, NDArray]:
+     """创建归一化网格 [0, 1] x [0, 1]
+     
+     Args:
+         num_x: x 方向点数
+         num_y: y 方向点数
+         
+     Returns:
+         (x_1d, y_1d, X, Y)
+     """
+     x_1d = np.linspace(0, 1, num_x, dtype=np.float32)
+     y_1d = np.linspace(0, 1, num_y, dtype=np.float32)
+     
+     X, Y = np.meshgrid(x_1d, y_1d, indexing='xy')
+     
+     return x_1d, y_1d, X, Y
+ 
+ 
+ def grid_to_points(X: NDArray, Y: NDArray) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """将网格转换为点列表
+     
+     Args:
+         X, Y: meshgrid 数组
+         
+     Returns:
+         点数组 (N, 2)
+     """
+     points = np.stack([X.ravel(), Y.ravel()], axis=-1)
+     return points.astype(np.float32)
+ 
+ 
+ def points_to_grid(
+     points: NDArray,
+     values: NDArray,
+     x_1d: NDArray,
+     y_1d: NDArray,
+ ) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """将点值插值到网格
+     
+     Args:
+         points: 点坐标 (N, 2)
+         values: 点值 (N,)
+         x_1d, y_1d: 目标网格坐标
+         
+     Returns:
+         网格值 (Ny, Nx)
+     """
+     from scipy.interpolate import griddata
+     
+     X, Y = np.meshgrid(x_1d, y_1d, indexing='xy')
+     grid_points = np.stack([X.ravel(), Y.ravel()], axis=-1)
+     
+     grid_values = griddata(points, values, grid_points, method='cubic')
+     grid_values = grid_values.reshape(X.shape)
+     
+     return grid_values.astype(np.float32)
+ 
+ 
+ def find_nearest_grid_point(
+     xy: NDArray,
+     x_1d: NDArray,
+     y_1d: NDArray,
+ ) -&gt; Tuple[NDArray, NDArray]:
+     """找到最近的网格点索引
+     
+     Args:
+         xy: 查询点 (N, 2)
+         x_1d, y_1d: 网格坐标
+         
+     Returns:
+         (i_indices, j_indices) 网格索引
+     """
+     # 找最近的 x 索引
+     x_diff = np.abs(xy[:, 0:1] - x_1d[np.newaxis, :])
+     j_indices = np.argmin(x_diff, axis=1)
+     
+     # 找最近的 y 索引
+     y_diff = np.abs(xy[:, 1:2] - y_1d[np.newaxis, :])
+     i_indices = np.argmin(y_diff, axis=1)
+     
+     return i_indices, j_indices
+ 
+ 
+ def bilinear_interpolate(
+     grid: NDArray,
+     xy: NDArray,
+     x_1d: NDArray,
+     y_1d: NDArray,
+ ) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """双线性插值
+     
+     Args:
+         grid: 网格值 (Ny, Nx)
+         xy: 查询点 (N, 2)
+         x_1d, y_1d: 网格坐标
+         
+     Returns:
+         插值结果 (N,)
+     """
+     dx = x_1d[1] - x_1d[0]
+     dy = y_1d[1] - y_1d[0]
+     
+     # 计算相对位置
+     x_rel = (xy[:, 0] - x_1d[0]) / dx
+     y_rel = (xy[:, 1] - y_1d[0]) / dy
+     
+     # 整数和小数部分
+     x0 = np.floor(x_rel).astype(int)
+     y0 = np.floor(y_rel).astype(int)
+     x1 = x0 + 1
+     y1 = y0 + 1
+     
+     # 裁剪到有效范围
+     x0 = np.clip(x0, 0, len(x_1d) - 1)
+     x1 = np.clip(x1, 0, len(x_1d) - 1)
+     y0 = np.clip(y0, 0, len(y_1d) - 1)
+     y1 = np.clip(y1, 0, len(y_1d) - 1)
+     
+     # 权重
+     wx = x_rel - np.floor(x_rel)
+     wy = y_rel - np.floor(y_rel)
+     
+     # 双线性插值
+     v00 = grid[y0, x0]
+     v01 = grid[y0, x1]
+     v10 = grid[y1, x0]
+     v11 = grid[y1, x1]
+     
+     result = (
+         v00 * (1 - wx) * (1 - wy) +
+         v01 * wx * (1 - wy) +
+         v10 * (1 - wx) * wy +
+         v11 * wx * wy
+     )
+     
+     return result.astype(np.float32)
+ 
+ 
+ def bilinear_interpolate_torch(
+     grid: torch.Tensor,
+     xy_norm: torch.Tensor,
+ ) -&gt; torch.Tensor:
+     """PyTorch 版双线性插值
+     
+     使用 grid_sample 实现可微插值。
+     
+     Args:
+         grid: 网格值 (B, 1, Ny, Nx) 或 (Ny, Nx)
+         xy_norm: 归一化坐标 (B, N, 2) 或 (N, 2)，范围 [0, 1]
+         
+     Returns:
+         插值结果 (B, N) 或 (N,)
+     """
+     squeeze_batch = False
+     if grid.dim() == 2:
+         grid = grid.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
+         squeeze_batch = True
+     elif grid.dim() == 3:
+         grid = grid.unsqueeze(1)
+     
+     if xy_norm.dim() == 2:
+         xy_norm = xy_norm.unsqueeze(0)
+     
+     # grid_sample 需要坐标在 [-1, 1] 范围
+     xy_sample = xy_norm * 2 - 1  # [0, 1] -&gt; [-1, 1]
+     
+     # grid_sample 期望 (B, N, 1, 2) 的坐标
+     xy_sample = xy_sample.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1, 2)
+     
+     # 插值
+     result = torch.nn.functional.grid_sample(
+         grid, xy_sample,
+         mode='bilinear',
+         padding_mode='border',
+         align_corners=True,
+     )
+     
+     # 结果形状 (B, 1, N, 1) -&gt; (B, N)
+     result = result.squeeze(1).squeeze(-1)
+     
+     if squeeze_batch:
+         result = result.squeeze(0)
+     
+     return result

+ """
+ 坐标归一化模块
+ """
+ 
+ from __future__ import annotations
+ 
+ from typing import Tuple, Optional
+ import numpy as np
+ from numpy.typing import NDArray
+ import torch
+ 
+ 
+ def normalize_coordinates(
+     xy: NDArray,
+     width: float,
+     length: float,
+ ) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """归一化坐标到 [0, 1]
+     
+     Args:
+         xy: 坐标 (N, 2)
+         width: 板宽度 W
+         length: 板长度 L
+         
+     Returns:
+         归一化坐标 (N, 2)
+     """
+     xy_norm = xy.copy()
+     xy_norm[:, 0] = xy[:, 0] / width
+     xy_norm[:, 1] = xy[:, 1] / length
+     return xy_norm.astype(np.float32)
+ 
+ 
+ def denormalize_coordinates(
+     xy_norm: NDArray,
+     width: float,
+     length: float,
+ ) -&gt; NDArray:
+     """反归一化坐标
+     
+     Args:
+         xy_norm: 归一化坐标 (N, 2)
+         width: 板宽度 W
+         length: 板长度 L
+         
+     Returns:
+         原始坐标 (N, 2)
+     """
+     xy = xy_norm.copy()
+     xy[:, 0] = xy_norm[:, 0] * width
+     xy[:, 1] = xy_norm[:, 1] * length
+     return xy.astype(np.float32)
+ 
+ 
+ def normalize_coordinates_torch(
+     xy: torch.Tensor,
+     width: float,
+     length: float,
+ ) -&gt; torch.Tensor:
+     """PyTorch 版坐标归一化
+     
+     Args:
+         xy: 坐标 (..., 2)
+         width: 板宽度
+         length: 板长度
+         
+     Returns:
+         归一化坐标 (..., 2)
+     """
+     xy_norm = xy.clone()
+     xy_norm[..., 0] = xy[..., 0] / width
+     xy_norm[..., 1] = xy[..., 1] / length
+     return xy_norm
+ 
+ 
+ def denormalize_coordinates_torch(
+     xy_norm: torch.Tensor,
+     width: float,
+     length: float,
+ ) -&gt; torch.Tensor:
+     """PyTorch 版坐标反归一化"""
+     xy = xy_norm.clone()
+     xy[..., 0] = xy_norm[..., 0] * width
+     xy[..., 1] = xy_norm[..., 1] * length
+     return xy
+ 
+ 
+ class CoordinateNormalizer:
+     """坐标归一化器
+     
+     封装归一化参数，提供便捷的转换方法。
+     """
+     
+     def __init__(self, width: float, length: float, y_clamp: Optional[float] = None):
+         """
+         Args:
+             width: 板宽度
+             length: 板长度
+             y_clamp: 夹持边界（如果指定，y 归一化到 [0, y_clamp/length]）
+         """
+         self.width = width
+         self.length = length
+         self.y_clamp = y_clamp
+         
+         # 有效区域的 y 范围
+         self.y_max = y_clamp if y_clamp is not None else length
+     
+     def normalize(self, xy: NDArray) -&gt; NDArray:
+         """归一化坐标"""
+         return normalize_coordinates(xy, self.width, self.length)
+     
+     def denormalize(self, xy_norm: NDArray) -&gt; NDArray:
+         """反归一化坐标"""
+         return denormalize_coordinates(xy_norm, self.width, self.length)
+     
+     def normalize_torch(self, xy: torch.Tensor) -&gt; torch.Tensor:
+         """PyTorch 归一化"""
+         return normalize_coordinates_torch(xy, self.width, self.length)
+     
+     def denormalize_torch(self, xy_norm: torch.Tensor) -&gt; torch.Tensor:
+         """PyTorch 反归一化"""
+         return denormalize_coordinates_torch(xy_norm, self.width, self.length)
+     
+     def is_in_valid_region(self, xy: NDArray) -&gt; NDArray:
+         """检查点是否在有效区域内
+         
+         Args:
+             xy: 坐标 (N, 2)
+             
+         Returns:
+             布尔掩码 (N,)
+         """
+         in_x = (xy[:, 0] &gt;= 0) &amp; (xy[:, 0] &lt;= self.width)
+         in_y = (xy[:, 1] &gt;= 0) &amp; (xy[:, 1] &lt;= self.y_max)
+         return in_x &amp; in_y
  
```
