+ 
+ class TestFiberPathCompatibility:
+     """FiberPath 兼容性测试"""
+     
+     def test_fiber_path_creation(self):
+         """测试 FiberPath 创建"""
+         x = np.array([0, 1, 1, 0])
+         y = np.array([0, 0, 1, 1])
+         
+         path = FiberPath(x, y)
+         
+         assert path.num_vertices == 4
+         assert np.allclose(path.x, x)
+         assert np.allclose(path.y, y)
+     
+     def test_fiber_path_evaluate(self):
+         """测试 FiberPath evaluate 方法"""
+         x = np.array([0, 1])
+         y = np.array([0, 0])
+         
+         path = FiberPath(x, y)
+         
+         s_query = np.array([0, 0.5, 1.0])
+         x_out, y_out = path.evaluate(s_query)
+         
+         assert np.allclose(x_out, [0, 0.5, 1.0], rtol=1e-5)
+         assert np.allclose(y_out, [0, 0, 0], atol=1e-5)
+     
+     def test_fiber_path_tangent(self):
+         """测试 FiberPath tangent 方法"""
+         x = np.array([0, 1])
+         y = np.array([0, 0])
+         
+         path = FiberPath(x, y)
+         
+         s_query = np.array([0, 0.5, 1.0])
+         tx, ty = path.tangent(s_query)
+         
+         assert np.allclose(tx, [1, 1, 1], rtol=1e-5)
+         assert np.allclose(ty, [0, 0, 0], atol=1e-5)
+     
+     def test_fiber_path_resample(self):
+         """测试 FiberPath resample 方法"""
+         x = np.array([0, 1, 1])
+         y = np.array([0, 0, 1])
+         
+         path = FiberPath(x, y)
+         
+         s, x_new, y_new, tx, ty = path.resample(num_points=21)
+         
+         assert len(s) == 21
+         assert len(x_new) == 21
+         assert len(y_new) == 21
+         assert len(tx) == 21
+         assert len(ty) == 21
+ 
+ 
+ class TestEdgeCases:
+     """边界情况测试"""
+     
+     def test_single_point(self):
+         """测试单点路径"""
+         points = np.array([[0.5, 0.5]])
+         path = PolylinePath(points)
+         
+         assert path.num_vertices == 1
+         assert path.total_length == 0
+     
+     def test_two_identical_points(self):
+         """测试两个相同点"""
+         points = np.array([[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]])
+         path = PolylinePath(points)
+         
+         assert path.total_length &lt; 1e-6
+     
+     def test_very_short_segment(self):
+         """测试非常短的线段"""
+         points = np.array([[0, 0], [1e-6, 0], [1, 0]])
+         path = PolylinePath(points)
+         
+         # 应该能正常处理
+         samples = path.sample_by_arclength(num_points=10)
+         assert len(samples) == 10
+     
+     def test_many_vertices(self):
+         """测试大量顶点"""
+         n = 1000
+         t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, n)
+         x = np.cos(t)
+         y = np.sin(t)
+         points = np.stack([x, y], axis=-1)
+         
+         path = PolylinePath(points)
+         
+         # 圆的周长约为 2π
+         assert np.isclose(path.total_length, 2 * np.pi, rtol=0.01)
+         
+         samples = path.sample_by_arclength(num_points=100)
+         assert len(samples) == 100
+ 
+ 
+ if __name__ == '__main__':
+     pytest.main([__file__, '-v'])

print(f'✓ 重采样间距误差: {spacing_error:.2e}')

assert samples.xy[:, 0].max() <= 0.28 + 1e-6, '超出右边界'
print(f'✓ 蛇形路径: 长度={path.total_length:.4f}m, 顶点数={path.num_vertices}')

print(f'✓ 直角路径长度: {path.total_length:.4f}', flush=True)

# 测试3: 切线单位化
samples = path.sample_by_arclength(num_points=100)
tangent_norms = np.linalg.norm(samples.tangent, axis=1)

print(f'✓ 切线归一化: 范数范围 [{tangent_norms.min():.6f}, {tangent_norms.max():.6f}]', flush=True)

# 测试4: 重采样间距

expected_spacing = path.total_length / 99
spacing_error = np.max(np.abs(ds - expected_spacing))
assert spacing_error < 1e-5, f'间距误差过大: {spacing_error}'
print(f'✓ 重采样间距误差: {spacing_error:.2e}', flush=True)

# 测试5: 网格节点路径
nodes = [(0, 0), (4, 0), (4, 2)]
path = create_path_from_grid_nodes(nodes, grid_spacing=0.05)
expected_length = 0.3
assert abs(path.total_length - expected_length) < 1e-5, f'网格路径长度错误: {path.total_length}'
print(f'✓ 网格节点路径长度: {path.total_length:.4f}m', flush=True)

# 测试6: 转角圆弧过渡
points = np.array([[0, 0], [1, 0], [1, 1]])
path_sharp = PolylinePath(points, corner_radius=0.0)
path_arc = PolylinePath(points, corner_radius=0.1)
assert path_arc.total_length < path_sharp.total_length, '圆弧路径应该更短'
print(f'✓ 转角圆弧: 尖角={path_sharp.total_length:.4f}, 圆弧={path_arc.total_length:.4f}', flush=True)

# 测试7: 蛇形路径
path = create_serpentine_path(width=0.3, length=1.0, num_passes=3)
samples = path.sample_by_arclength(num_points=100)
assert samples.xy[:, 0].min() >= 0.02 - 1e-6, '超出左边界'
assert samples.xy[:, 0].max() <= 0.28 + 1e-6, '超出右边界'
print(f'✓ 蛇形路径: 长度={path.total_length:.4f}m, 顶点数={path.num_vertices}', flush=True)

# 测试8: FiberPath 兼容性
x = np.array([0, 1, 1])
y = np.array([0, 0, 1])

print(f'✓ FiberPath 兼容: resample 返回 {len(s_new)} 点', flush=True)

print(flush=True)
print('=== 所有测试通过 ===', flush=True)

+     assert samples.xy[:, 0].max() &lt;= 0.28 + 1e-6, '超出右边界'
+     print(f'✓ 蛇形路径: 长度={path.total_length:.4f}m, 顶点数={path.num_vertices}')
+ 
+     # 测试8: FiberPath 兼容性
+     x = np.array([0, 1, 1])
+     y = np.array([0, 0, 1])
+     fiber_path = FiberPath(x, y)
+     s_new, x_new, y_new, tx, ty = fiber_path.resample(num_points=21)
+     assert len(s_new) == 21, 'resample 返回长度错误'
+     print(f'✓ FiberPath 兼容: resample 返回 {len(s_new)} 点')
+ 
+     print()
+     print('=== 所有测试通过 ===')
+ 
+ if __name__ == '__main__':
+     test_all()
